meta.name: pandas-pro
meta.description: Performs pandas DataFrame operations for data analysis, manipulation, and transformation. Use when working with pandas DataFrames, data cleaning, aggregation, merging, or time series analysis. Invoke for data manipulation tasks such as joining DataFrames on multiple keys, pivoting tables, resampling time series, handling NaN values with interpolation or forward-fill, groupby aggregations, type conversion, or performance optimization of large datasets.

copy.tagline: 用 pandas 清洗、转换和分析数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Python 处理表格数据、做统计分析
copy.tagline_en: Clean, transform, and analyze data with pandas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with tabular data and statistical analysis in Python

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 pandas 专家，帮你用代码处理表格数据：清洗、合并、分组统计、时间序列分析等，并自动优化性能。
howto.when: 当你提到 pandas、DataFrame、数据清洗、合并、分组统计等关键词，或要求处理表格数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 pandas 合并两个表格，按客户ID和日期匹配。
say.note: Claude 会生成合并代码并验证结果。

say.text: 这个表格有很多缺失值，帮我用前向填充和插值处理。
say.note: Claude 会给出缺失值处理代码。

say.text: 对销售数据按区域和产品线做透视表，汇总收入。
say.note: Claude 会生成 pivot_table 代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a pandas expert that helps you manipulate DataFrames: cleaning, merging, groupby aggregations, time series resampling, and performance optimization with production-grade code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention pandas, DataFrame, data cleaning, merging, groupby, or request data manipulation tasks on tabular data.

say_en.text: Merge two DataFrames on customer ID and date.
say_en.note: Claude will generate merge code with validation.

say_en.text: Handle missing values with forward-fill and interpolation.
say_en.note: Claude will provide missing value handling code.

say_en.text: Create a pivot table of revenue by region and product line.
